newsitem.title: USA: United Cities gets rate increase in Ga.
newsitem.headline: United Cities gets rate increase in Ga.

text.p: United Cities Gas Co said on Monday that the Georgia Public Service Commission has granted the company a $3.2 million annual rate increase.
An overall rate increase of approximately 6.6 percent went into effect on December 2 for about 70,000 customers in Columbus and Gainesville, Georgia, United Cities said.
The rate increase provides United Cities with a 10.1 percent return on rate base and an 11.5 percent return on common equity, the company said.
The increase is the result of an application filed before the commission in May, the company said.
